description:
Project Overview

The University of Twente is recruiting a PhD researcher within the EU DEFORM project to develop explainable methods for detecting manipulated video. The research combines foundation models with evidence from both visual and audio signals.

Research Position Overview

Move beyond a binary deepfake verdict by identifying traces that explain why media appears manipulated. Collaborate with DEFORM partners on methods relevant to forensic investigation and trustworthy media.

Research Areas

  • Explainable deepfake detection
  • Foundation models and computer vision
  • Audio–video consistency analysis
